question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing cheerleader, Claire is playing sweeper, Dave is playing right winger, Eve is playing benchwarmer, Fred is playing center midfielder, and Gertrude is playing left midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Fred and Eve trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Then, Eve and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Fred and Dave trade positions. Then, Dave and Fred trade positions. Finally, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) cheerleader
(C) sweeper
(D) right winger
(E) benchwarmer
(F) center midfielder
(G) left midfielder
solution:
Positions in order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (right back, cheerleader, sweeper, right winger, benchwarmer, center midfielder, left midfielder).
1. Dave ↔ Alice: (right winger, cheerleader, sweeper, right back, benchwarmer, center midfielder, left midfielder).
2. Fred ↔ Eve: (right winger, cheerleader, sweeper, right back, center midfielder, benchwarmer, left midfielder).
3. Bob ↔ Eve: (right winger, center midfielder, sweeper, right back, cheerleader, benchwarmer, left midfielder).
4. Eve ↔ Gertrude: (right winger, center midfielder, sweeper, right back, left midfielder, benchwarmer, cheerleader).
5. Fred ↔ Dave: (right winger, center midfielder, sweeper, benchwarmer, left midfielder, right back, cheerleader).
6. Dave ↔ Fred: (right winger, center midfielder, sweeper, right back, left midfielder, benchwarmer, cheerleader).
7. Dave ↔ Gertrude: (right winger, center midfielder, sweeper, cheerleader, left midfielder, benchwarmer, right back).
Bob is playing center midfielder, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
